info.title: MilliAPI Micropaid APIs
info.description: Decision-ready web intelligence for AI agents. Use the free preflight when purchase value is uncertain; use the flagship audit for a verdict plus machine-applicable repair artifacts, repair verification after applying fixes, site-readiness-change for later monitoring, and batch for lists. A free framework-neutral agent tool manifest describes the recommended tools and x402 invocation semantics. Paid endpoints use x402 v2 with USDC on Base mainnet.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Optional 8-200 character client key for best-effort replay of a successful identical request within the same warm runtime.

get.summary: Get a decision-ready AI web-readiness verdict, remediation plan, and repair artifacts
get.description: Flagship one-site service. Returns score, verdict, blockers, evidence, prioritized fixes, repair artifacts classified as ready-to-apply/review-required/fill-required, raw observations, best-effort cache metadata, and a portable baseline token.

post.summary: Verify which previously recommended repairs actually worked
post.description: Performs a fresh uncached re-audit against a prior portable baseline. Returns resolved, remaining, and newly introduced recommendation IDs, score delta, current repair artifacts, and a new baseline.

post.summary: Compare a site against a portable baseline from a prior audit
post.description: Stateless historical comparison. Caller supplies the baseline token returned by a prior audit; MilliAPI returns exact readiness changes, current repair artifacts, and a fresh token for the next comparison.

200.description: Score/verdict delta, exact changes, current summary and repair artifacts, and next baseline token
